metadata.title: Four-Dimensional Semi-Homogeneous Convex Cones: A Complete Classification
metadata.abstract: We classify all four-dimensional semi-homogeneous convex cones, i.e., closed, pointed, full-dimensional cones whose connected automorphism group has principal orbits of codimension at most one. On such cones, the Monge-Ampère equation defining the canonical barrier reduces to an ordinary differential equation. This makes this barrier computationally accessible. The semi-homogeneous cones can then be used in modeling by conic programs. An obvious subset of such cones are the homogeneous cones. The key point allowing the classification is that for all other cones, the automorphism group has a three-dimensional subgroup acting locally faithfully on the principal orbits. This subgroup must have a Lie algebra which is either abelian or a direct product of a 1-dimensional algebra and a two-dimensional algebra generated by $A,B$ satisfying $[A,B]=B$. In both cases we classify all 4-dimensional representations up to isomorphism, and for each representation all invariant convex cones. For every cone an orbit invariant is computed.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 对闭、尖、满维且连通自同构群主轨道余维至多一的四维凸锥，作者给出完整分类。非齐性情形归结为局部忠实作用的三维子群，其Lie代数为阿贝尔或一维代数与二维仿射代数的直积；分类四维表示及不变凸锥，并计算轨道不变量。
techniques: 三维Lie子群与四维表示分类
analysis.breakthrough: 使这类锥的canonical barrier方程降为常微分方程，为锥规划提供可计算模型。
analysis.limitations: 完整性仅指四维半齐性且所述凸性条件，不是所有四维凸锥。障碍函数可约化为ODE不等于已给所有情形初等闭式或算法复杂度。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。29页PDF提取完整、页数匹配、无短文本页；现有全文与元数据披露检索未发现作者AI使用声明。已完成点写AI、断行模型名和Danus补检及相关语境复核；未披露不表示确认未使用。

analysis.priorityReason: 特殊齐性几何与Monge–Ampère方程相关，分析用途值得关注。
